evidence_basis: PubMed abstract (efetch PMID 41247792) and GEO series/sample records only; no full text
assay: bulk RNA-seq, human skeletal muscle biopsies (NovaSeq X Plus; STAR + RSEM; edgeR v4.0.16 per GEO data_processing)
subjects: n = 9 (7 M, 2 F), 24 +/- 1 yr; randomized crossover
repeated_measure_unit: subject (each subject biopsied pre and post in both trials)
primary_estimand: Within-subject effect of 60 min cycling at 65% VO2max on muscle gene expression (4 h post vs pre) in each trial, plus IN vs A at rest and the trial x exercise interaction
planned_contrasts: IN vs A at rest (Pre) (abstract: 9 DEGs)
trial x exercise interaction (abstract: GSEA only, no DEG count)
paper_method: edgeR GLM (GEO data_processing: 'Differential expression estimation with edgeR v4.0.16'; supplementary file names 'edgeRglm_Counts_...')

paper_threshold.source_locator: abstract has no DEG threshold; full text not available

inclusion: GEO holds 28 of 36 possible biopsies across 9 subjects (I02-I11, no I08): A-Pre 7, A-Post 7, IN-Pre 6, IN-Post 8
